nurse.text: What about ye! Welcome to the Belfast Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter, love, and we'll sort them out.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Right. Have a seat, there's a cuppa on, and I'll not say a word about the weather. It's got enough to say for itself.
All done. They're right as rain, which is a bit rich because it's raining. Mind how you go.
The Ark? Aye, that's the terminal in the corner. It runs on very strong tea and a cousin from Lisburn.

else.text: No bother. Come in out of the wet any time. The kettle never stops.
